responsibility: Handles shipment registration with origin, destination, and delivery deadline; assigns unique tracking identifiers; manages route selection, destination changes, and replanning by coordinating with routing; maintains the shipment/cargo aggregate and its delivery status.

Computes and returns candidate routes (itineraries) compatible with a shipment's origin, destination, and delivery deadline via graph traversal over voyages and locations, informing when no feasible route exists.

Records logistics events (receipt, loading, unloading, customs, pickup) across operational, integration/REST, mobile, and file-based channels; validates events against existing shipment, location, and trip; triggers shipment status recalculation while ensuring uniform rules and traceability of occurrence and recording times.

Provides shipment lookup by tracking identifier and presents current status, last known location, ETA, event history, plan adherence, route deviations, and consolidated administrative views grouped by business status.
